trace_summary.task_objective: A fixed three-hop retrieval pipeline over Wikipedia abstracts. It performs exactly three retrievals and returns the concatenation of everything retrieved. The claim is: 'Mikhail Glinka is not the same nationality as another opera composer. This composer wrote the opera "I puritani"'
trace_summary.final_output_summary: 24 documents returned across three hops. Hop 1 retrieved 7 documents including information about Mikhail Glinka (Russian) and Vincenzo Bellini (Italian composer of 'I puritani'). Hop 2 retrieved 7 documents confirming Bellini's authorship and nationality. Hop 3 retrieved 10 documents including dedicated articles on both composers.
trace_summary.summary: The three-hop retrieval pipeline executed all seven specified steps successfully. Hop 1 retrieved documents establishing that Mikhail Glinka was Russian and Vincenzo Bellini (composer of 'I puritani') was Italian. The summarizer correctly identified the claim as TRUE based on the nationality difference. Subsequent hops retrieved additional confirming documents. All three retrievals completed as specified, and 24 documents were returned in the final output. The summaries embedded verdict language ('The claim is TRUE'), which is their specified output format as verification summaries. The query generators produced retrieval queries as required. No steps failed to execute, and all structural obligations were met.
